text:
sara_ae: Heads-up  NimbusRetail POC next week. They prefer WebSocket streaming (node + go samples), need in-stream function/tool calls to their order-service (sync POSTs with idempotency), and strict JSON schema outputs. They also asked about on-prem/private deployment options and sent a security questionnaire. Budget cap ~12k/mo. Any quick blockers?

ben_se: I can drive integration. Quick clarifiers: (1) WebSocket ok vs SSE? (2) do they want our runtime to retry or handle at-most-once delivery?

sara_ae: WebSocket preferred for low-latency; retry visible in runtime is fine but webhook must be idempotent. Target: 95th <= 300ms. They mentioned potential on-prem later but want hosted POC first.

zoe_devex: I'll produce tiny node + go samples and a one-pager. Debug tips: enable SDK trace and use the live-debug harness. Node snippet: 
```
// node example
const {Client} = require('redwood-sdk');
const c = new Client({apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, debug: true});
const ws = c.wsStream({model: 'redwood-medium'});
ws.on('message', msg => console.log(msg));
```
Also include `response_format: 'jsonschema'` + `top_level_schema` example and a `--force-region=eu-west` flag for residency checks.

claire_sre: For EU/on-prem requests: recommend Hosted EU nodes for POC with sidecar redaction, or Dedicated eu-west if they need low-latency SLA. Private on-prem package is possible but adds setup time and a platform fee. Hosted estimate ~4k-6k/mo; Dedicated small pool to meet 300ms 95p ~9k-11k/mo. Will prepare a short cost table.

ben_se: Implementation notes: (1) For function/tool calls over websocket, emit `tool_invocation` events with {call_id, idempotency_key, payload} as a top-level envelope so the runtime and telemetry can correlate. (2) Keep `batching.window_ms` small during POC, e.g., 5ms, and set `max_batch_tokens` close to average request size to avoid spikes. (3) Add client-side JSON schema validation as a fail-fast.

security-bot: Security checklist created: SEC-2026-1142. Requested artifacts: SOC2 summary, dataflow diagram, KMS/HSM options, retention policy, staff access list, and test plan for on-prem migration.

zoe_devex: ETA for samples + checklist: EOD tomorrow. Will include node + go examples, websocket harness, a small order-service webhook emulator, schema validator, `--force-region` flag, and a one-paragraph security reply tailored to their questionnaire.

ops-bot: Ticket created POC-NIM-2026-21: "NimbusRetail POC - websocket streaming + function-calls + schema + security" assigned to @zoe_devex, @ben_se.

ben_se: Also recommend preconfiguring monitoring: token-level dashboard, trace ids for every tool invocation, and a spend alert at $1k/day. Keep `max_tokens` conservative.

sara_ae: Great. Can you include a short blurb I can paste into the questionnaire about data residency and KMS (hosted EU + customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private)?

claire_sre: Will draft that blurb and attach the assumptions. Also will run a quick cost calc for 10k req/day @60 tokens/req and share.

zoe_devex: I'll add a troubleshooting note: to capture traces run `REDWOOD_SDK_TRACE=1 node ws_sample.js > trace.log` and include the trace id when filing support tickets.

ben_se: One more: for the webhook ensure they accept `Idempotency-Key` header and return 200/409 semantics for dedup. We'll include a tiny test harness for that.

sara_ae: Perfect, thanks team :thumbsup:
